title: dipdoop's Totally Awesome Iron (Create Compat)
description: This resource pack makes raw iron much more accurate, but making it chicken nuggets.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81f00e71834b261e5b90fc26f090822a3a2c248a.png)
For this pack to work properly it needs my other pack ([dipdoop's Totally Awesome Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dipdoops-totally-awesome-pack))

This makes it so that Iron Sheets are more accurate to what raw iron truly is; chicken nuggets. So this simple pack just adds a flattened chicken nugget inplace of the sheet.
